title: Two Sum
hint: Use a hash map to store complements
explanation: Iterate through the array and check if the complement exists in the hash map. If it does, return the indices.

title: Valid Parentheses
hint: Use a stack to track opening brackets
explanation: Push opening brackets onto a stack. When encountering a closing bracket, check if it matches the top of the stack.

title: Merge Two Sorted Lists
hint: Use a dummy node to simplify the merging process
explanation: Compare nodes from both lists and link them in sorted order. Continue until one list is exhausted.
